## Triggr

An **Activator-lite** for rootless Dopamine. Pick a trigger, pick what it runs, in **Settings → Triggr**. Triggr only changes a button when you assign something to it.

- **Triggers:** Home button (single, double, triple, short and long hold), Touch ID light double tap, lock button (single, double, triple, hold), volume buttons (presses, holds, up-then-down, both), mute switch, status bar taps, **Home Screen icon flicks** (any icon or one app's icon), **shake**, charger and headphones, Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / Low Power / lock / screen changes.
- **Custom events:** a specific Wi-Fi network or Bluetooth device, battery level, an app opening, a time of day.
- **Actions:** Home, App Switcher, Last App, Quit App, Control Center, Notification Center, Spotlight, Siri, screenshot, Sleep, Lock, Respring, Power Off Slider, Safe Mode, Restart, Power Off; switches for Flashlight, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Airplane Mode, Cellular Data, Do Not Disturb, Low Power Mode, Rotation Lock, Mute, Dark Mode, Night Shift, Auto-Brightness, Keep Screen Awake and Location Services; media controls; brightness and volume levels; apps, URLs, Shortcuts, Settings pages and shell commands; pop-up menus.
- **Several actions per trigger**, with pauses and reordering.
- **Places:** Anywhere, Home Screen, In Apps, Lock Screen.
- **Extras:** block list, action banners, profiles, export / import of setups, an opt-in API and a `triggr` command-line tool.

- **Replace Button Actions:** One toggle (Options, on by default) for every button and the mute switch: an assigned press runs instead of the button's own action, like Activator. Nothing assigned = the normal action, Do Nothing = blocked. Turn it off to run everything alongside.
- **Mute switch:** With Replace on, an assigned flip runs instead of muting or unmuting.
- **Clearer settings:** Unassigned button triggers show their default ("Default: Lock"), and the picker says how to keep it too (e.g. add Sleep to still lock).
- **Instant Triple → Sleep:** The screen goes dark right at the third press; the lock follows once Triggr is sure it's not a 4th press (Emergency SOS). Also fixes Triple → Sleep not locking on iOS 16.
- **A12 and newer:** The repo build now includes arm64e, so A12+ (iPhone XS / XR and later) can install it straight from here.

**iOS 15–16, rootless Dopamine. arm64 and arm64e (A12 and newer).**

- **A12 and newer (iPhone XS / XR and later):** new in beta6 and not confirmed on a device yet. Phones without a Home button don't see the Home Button or Touch ID triggers, and the lock button is called the Side Button. If it lands you in safe mode, uninstall Triggr from Sileo, and please report how it goes.
- Tested on an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11)** with iOS 16.7 and an **iPhone 7 (A10)** with iOS 15.8.6, both on Dopamine.

Triggr is in **public beta**. Please report bugs, crashes and requests on the **[Triggr beta GitHub](https://github.com/Jond-ie/triggr-beta)** ([open an issue](https://github.com/Jond-ie/triggr-beta/issues/new/choose)), with your device, iOS version, jailbreak and Triggr version.

- **Buttons:** with **Options → Replace Button Actions** on (the default), an assigned press runs instead of the button's own action; add the matching action (like **Sleep** for the lock button) to keep it too. Emergency SOS, waking and force restart are left to iOS, but check SOS still starts if you rely on it.
- **Restart** and **Power Off** act at once and turn the jailbreak off until you run Dopamine again.
- **Safe Mode** uses ElleKit's own Safe Mode; leave it from its Safe Mode screen.
- Requires **AltList** (BigBoss) and PreferenceLoader; Sileo installs them automatically.
Original work by **John d_ie**, inspired by Activator (Ryan Petrich). Developed with AI assistance (Claude Code) and tested on-device.
